body.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM http_logs WHERE request = 'GET / HTTP/1.0';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM http_logs WHERE request = 'GET / HTTP/1.0' AND status = 200;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM http_logs WHERE `@timestamp` >= toDateTime64('1998-05-01 00:00:00.000', 3) AND `@timestamp` < toDateTime64('1998-06-01 00:00:00.000', 3);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM http_logs WHERE status = 200 AND `@timestamp` >= toDateTime64('1998-05-01 00:00:00.000', 3) AND `@timestamp` < toDateTime64('1998-05-02 00:00:00.000', 3);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM http_logs WHERE status = 400 AND `@timestamp` >= toDateTime64('1998-05-01 00:00:00.000', 3) AND `@timestamp` < toDateTime64('1998-05-02 00:00:00.000', 3);
SELECT toStartOfHour(`@timestamp`) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS c FROM http_logs GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;
SELECT toStartOfHour(`@timestamp`) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS c FROM http_logs WHERE status = 200 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;

SELECT toStartOfHour(`@timestamp`) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(size) AS avg_size, MIN(size) AS min_size, MAX(size) AS max_size, SUM(size) AS sum_size FROM http_logs WHERE status = 200 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;

SELECT clientip, status, size, COUNT(*) AS c FROM http_logs WHERE `@timestamp` >= toDateTime64('1998-05-03 00:00:00.000', 3) AND `@timestamp` < toDateTime64('1998-05-07 00:00:00.000', 3) GROUP BY clientip, status, size ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 100;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM http_logs WHERE size >= 20 AND size <= 200;
SELECT `@timestamp`, clientip, request, status, size FROM http_logs ORDER BY `@timestamp` DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT `@timestamp`, clientip, request, status, size FROM http_logs ORDER BY `@timestamp` ASC LIMIT 10;
SELECT `@timestamp`, clientip, request, status, size FROM http_logs ORDER BY size DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT `@timestamp`, clientip, request, status, size FROM http_logs ORDER BY size ASC LIMIT 10;
